name: Janet AI
long_description:
Janet AI lets you deploy reliable, cost-efficient 24/7 agents across every workflow, powered by custom agent memory and decision infrastructure we built for company operations. Janet remembers everything it sees and does across all your tools, and recalls exactly the right context at the moment it's needed.

Connect your tools and scope permissions in a few clicks, describe your flows in plain English, and always-on agents handle the work, all while learning what's going on across your company.

Janet AI is backed by Y Combinator, Formosa Capital, Paul Graham, Charles Ferguson, and others.

Check us out at janet.ai!
one_liner: Agents that learn your company and work 24/7
